question: Does any subset of the frozen five-piece v15 attention core recover target behavior while remaining selective on independently capability-qualified, token-position-aligned P and C controls?
novelty_and_correction: The exact target lattice and its .80536/.86829 full-mask A1/A2 behavior are preserved. The old selectivity terminal is retracted because legacy P/C pairs were patched across unequal token positions. This is the first causal execution of the frozen masks on equal-length, semantically aligned, prospectively capability-qualified controls.
population: Exactly 16 A1, 16 A2, 16 aligned P, and 16 aligned C rows. A1/A2 are byte-for-byte the prior v15 targets. P/C are the sealed aligned-control authority and were 16/16 jointly capable per panel before causal access.

candidate_rule.derivation: Frozen before the aligned-control outcomes from the valid v15 target-side module/head/greedy evidence and the already-executed five-piece lattice. No component, mask, gain, or threshold is changed after control repair.

intervention: For all 32 masks, jointly replace each selected complete 128-dimensional head response slice and/or attention 15's complete nine-head response through the common terminal semantic position. Execute the native suffix and report target behavior/final residual plus full-vocabulary KL and top-one changes separately for P and C.
selection: An eligible mask has A1 signed behavioral projection >=.75, A1 direction fraction >=.875, zero top-one flips in P, zero top-one flips in C, and max(P median KL, C median KL) <=.02. Select fewest pieces, then largest A1 projection, then smallest mask. Pooled-control metrics are reported but never select. A2 never selects.

predictions.pred_a_authority_alignment_capability_la: All hashes, exact target preservation, per-row alignment, perfect capability ancestry, 32 unique masks, self closure <=1e-4, finite metrics, and exactly 35 forwards pass.
predictions.pred_b_target_sufficient_separately_sele: At least one mask is A1-eligible under separate P and C rules.
predictions.pred_c_selected_subset_confirms_without_: The selected mask reaches A2 signed behavioral projection >=.75 and direction fraction >=.875.
predictions.pred_d_selected_subset_is_proper: The selected mask uses at most four of five pieces.
predictions.pred_e_every_selected_piece_is_necessary: Removing any selected piece makes A1 ineligible or lowers A1 signed projection by at least .05.
predictions.pred_f_final_residual_tracks_selected_be: The selected mask has full-final-residual signed projection >=.50 on both A1 and A2.

terminal_policy.aligned_attention_construction_failure: A and B pass but C fails.
terminal_policy.partial: A passes and no more specific terminal applies.

next_branch: If a selective subset confirms, freeze it for genuinely fresh target/control families and then translate its attention OV/QK/value edges into upstream writers and downstream readers. If none exists, preserve the attention core as target-path evidence and split causally live MLP responses using a finite task/control response operator rather than hidden magnitude.
